faq-1.question: What does the platform offer?
faq-1.answer: Web hosting, domain registration and transfer, virtual and dedicated servers, and a client portal for ordering, billing and support.

faq-2.question: How do I get started?
faq-2.answer: Choose a plan or search for a domain, create an account and pay the first invoice. Most services are activated automatically.

faq-3.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
faq-3.answer: Cards and the other methods enabled at checkout. Invoices can be paid from the client portal at any time.

faq-4.question: How does billing work?
faq-4.answer: Services are billed per cycle, monthly or yearly. Invoices are issued ahead of the due date and reminders are sent by email.

faq-5.question: How do I contact support?
faq-5.answer: Open a ticket from the client portal or use the contact page. Support is available 24/7.

faq-6.question: Can I move my existing site?
faq-6.answer: Yes. Migration is free on all annual plans, including databases and mail.

faq-7.question: How do I register or transfer a domain?
faq-7.answer: Search for the name on the domains page and add it to your cart. To transfer, unlock the domain with your current registrar and provide the EPP code.

faq-8.question: Is an SSL certificate included?
faq-8.answer: Yes, a free SSL certificate is included in every hosting plan.

faq-9.question: Can I upgrade my plan later?
faq-9.answer: Yes. You can upgrade a service from the client portal at any time.

faq-10.question: Are backups included?
faq-10.answer: Daily backups are included in every hosting plan.
